mapper.select: SELECT m.CODE, m.NAME, m.ID, m.RATING, m.POINT, DATE_FORMAT(m.CREATED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS createdAt, ( SELECT i.PATH FROM IMAGES i WHERE i.TARGET_CODE = m.CODE AND i.TYPE = 'profile' AND i.DELETE_YN = 0 ORDER BY i.ORDER_SEQ ASC, i.PATH ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS path FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT m WHERE m.CODE = #{memberCode} AND m.DELETE_YN = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ce.CHAL_CODE) FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce WHERE ce.MEM_CODE = #{memberCode} AND ce.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL AND ce.DELETE_YN = 0

SELECT ranked.ranking FROM ( SELECT m.CODE AS memberCode, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COALESCE(completed.completedCount, 0) DESC ) AS ranking FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ce.MEM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.CHAL_CODE) AS completedCount FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce WHERE ce.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL AND ce.DELETE_YN = 0 GROUP BY ce.MEM_CODE ) completed ON completed.MEM_CODE = m.CODE WHERE m.DELETE_YN = 0 ) ranked WHERE ranked.memberCode = #{memberCode}
